description: Paid routes require a funded Base USDC wallet. Use readfetch-client / @readfetch/client or the MCP signing proxy (@readfetch/mcp-x402-proxy). Direct calls without a signing client will stop at 402. Screenshot a public URL in headless Chromium (page JavaScript runs; no ad blocker) and return PNG or JPEG in JSON — `image_base64`, `mime`, `width`, `height`, `status_code`, `billed` (not a hosted URL). Scope: viewport only (`full_page: false`), full scrollable page (default), or one element (`selector`). `mode` caps total render time: fast (15 s), render (30 s, default), full (60 s, always full-page regardless of `full_page`). Set `width`/`height` before navigation (default 1280×800, max 3840×2160). `delay_ms` (0–30000) waits after navigation, then captures — raise it or use `mode=full` for slow SPAs and lazy media. Prefer readfetch_text or readfetch_scrape for extractable text; readfetch_pdf for PDF files; readfetch_fetch for raw HTTP without rendering. Read-only on the origin (GET + render, no form POST). Bot-check or blank frames may still return pixels with `billed: false` and a `hint`; paid x402 like other routes.

delay_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after navigation before capture (0–30000); use for SPAs and lazy-loaded content.

format.description: Image encoding for `image_base64` (png default, or jpeg).

full_page.description: true (default): entire scrollable document; false: viewport only. Ignored when mode=full.

height.description: Viewport height in pixels before navigation (default 800, max 2160).

mode.description: Whole-call budget: fast (15 s), render (30 s, default), or full (60 s; always captures the full scrollable page).

selector.description: CSS selector — capture that element's box only. Omit for page/viewport per full_page.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to render in headless Chromium.

width.description: Viewport width in pixels before navigation (default 1280, max 3840).

name: readfetch_screenshot
